evidence_quotes.agenda: So before I go over pricing structure and estimate, do you have any questions any clarification regarding the moving process in general?
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: No, so far so good with everything. -- full credit applies per the no-concern-raised rule
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: if the move goes faster than what we have expected... you pay less, however if by chance the parking access might be more than what we have anticipated, of course there's a possibility that we pay more, I hope not

top_strength: Navigated an unusual two-pod-into-storage-plus-apartment move with genuine care -- got exact pod dimensions, flagged the parking-access unknowns honestly (including that costs could go up, not just down), and gave the customer a clear 'homework' assignment to firm up the estimate.
coaching_note: Quid pro quo framing, though excellent when it landed, only came after several logistics questions had already started -- get it in before any probing next time.
grading_note: two_layers_deep scored 15 via the no-concern-raised rule.
